Data was collected through interviews from 30 Grade 9 learners from two schools in the Western Cape Province of South Africa. Findings indicate that learners' conceptions of triangle congruence can be categorised according to four levels of conceptualisation, namely, visual, analytic, formal and axiomatic levels. Learners at the visual level rely solely on visual appearance when determining congruent triangles. Learners at the analytic level use measurements of corresponding sides and angles when determining congruent triangles. Formal and axiomatic levels were not observed in this study. Implications for teaching are discussed.

Active matrix imaging (AMI) refers to a display technology where each pixel is individually addressed by a thin-film transistor (TFT). AMI is also called active matrix liquid crystal display (AMLCD).

Techopedia explains Active Matrix Imaging

AMI was developed to overcome the shortcomings of passive matrix imaging (PMI), where pixels were addressed by row and column scanning, which resulted in slow refresh rates and poor image quality.

In AMI, each pixel has its own TFT switch and capacitor that controls the amount of light passing through that particular pixel. This results in faster response times, better contrast ratios and sharper images than PMI.

AMI is widely used in flat-panel displays for laptops, desktop monitors, televisions and mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets.What Is The Difference Between Active And Passive Matrix Displays?

The main difference between active and passive matrix displays lies in how individual pixels are addressed and controlled.

Passive Matrix Displays:

Addressing Method: In passive matrix displays, rows and columns of electrodes intersect at each pixel location. By applying voltages to specific row and column electrodes, pixels at their intersection can be turned on or off.

Response Time: Passive matrix displays generally have slower response times compared to active matrix displays. This can result in ghosting or smearing when displaying fast-moving content.

Contrast and Viewing Angles: These displays tend to have poorer contrast ratios and narrower viewing angles. Colors might appear washed out when viewed from off-center angles.

Complexity and Cost: They are simpler in design and generally less expensive to manufacture.

REPUBLIKA.CO.ID, JAKARTA -- Menteri Koordinator Bidang Kemaritiman Luhut Pandjaitan meminta pemerintah pusat dan daerah bersinergi menangani masalah sampah plastik di lautan.

"Sampah plastik yang ada di darat akan terbawa air hujan ke laut," kata Luhut dalam keterangan tertulis yang diterima di Jakarta, Minggu (2/9).

Menko Maritim Luhut mengakui, Indonesia merupakan penyumbang sampah plastik terbesar kedua di dunia setelah China. "Sampah-sampah itu tidak dibuang sembarangan, tapi terbawa arus air hujan," kata dia.

Menurut Luhut, pemerintah pusat dan daerah perlu bersinergi mengatasi masalah tersebut. "Saya minta pemerintah pusat dan daerah bersinergi agar sampah-sampah itu tidak sampai ke laut," kata dia.

Luhut menjelaskan, saat ini Kementerian Kelautanan dan Perikanan (KKP) tengah menyusun peta sebaran sampah plastik di lautan Indonesia. "Mereka sedang membuat peta sebaran sampah-sampah itu," kata dia.

Menurut Luhut, KKP juga tengah merumuskan langkah-langkah strategis untuk mengurangi sampah plastik di lautan. "Mereka sedang merumuskan apa saja yang harus dilakukan," kata dia.

Sebelumnya, Direktur Eksekutis The Ocean Cleanup Boyan Slat menyebut Indonesia menjadi penyumbang sampah plastik terbesar kedua di dunia setelah China.

Boyan Slat mengungkapkan, dari 8 juta ton sampah plastik yang berakhir di lautan setiap tahunnya, sebanyak 3,5 juta ton berasal dari Asia Tenggara. "Indonesia menyumbangkan lebih dari 1 juta metrik ton," kata Boyan.#BersihDariPlastik #IndonesiaTanpaPlastik

Abstract algebra is the study of algebraic structures. Algebraic structures consist of sets equipped with one or more operations that satisfy certain axioms. Examples include groups, rings, fields, modules, vector spaces, algebras over a field and lattices. Abstract algebra distinguishes itself from elementary algebra by generalizing arithmetic operations beyond addition, multiplication and their inverses to more abstract settings.

Abstract algebra has applications in cryptography, coding theory, error-correcting codes, quantum mechanics, particle physics and string theory.

Madu mengandung senyawa antimikroba dan antioksidan yang efektif meredakan batuk. Penelitian menunjukkan, madu lebih ampuh meredakan batuk dibandingkan sirup penekan batuk yang dijual di apotek.

What Is A Free Trade Area?

A free trade area (FTA) is a type of preferential trade area (PTA) in which member countries agree to eliminate tariffs, quotas, and preferences on most (if not all) goods and services traded among them. presidents. It was designed by James Madison, Alexander Hamilton and
others at the Constitutional Convention of 1787 as a compromise between
those delegates who wanted Congress to elect the president and those who
wanted popular vote.

The Electoral College consists of electors from each state and the
District of Columbia who meet every four years to cast ballots for
President and Vice President. Each state has as many electors as it does
members in Congress (Senators + Representatives). The District of
Columbia gets three electors because of the Twenty-third Amendment to the
Constitution.

There are currently 538 electors. A candidate must receive a majority
of electoral votes—270—to be elected President or Vice President. If no
one receives a majority, the House of Representatives elects the
President from among the top three vote-geters, with each state delegation
casting one vote. The Senate chooses the Vice President from among the top
two vote-geters, with each Senator casting one vote.

Electors are usually chosen by political parties on the basis of their
loyalty to that party and its nominee. In some states, electors are named
by party central committees; in others they are nominated at state party
conventions; in still others they are nominated by the presidential nominee
himself.

Electors meet on the first Monday after the Tuesday following the first
Wednesday in December in their state capitals to cast ballots for President
and Vice President. They then send certificates of vote to the President of
the Senate, who opens and counts them before a joint session of Congress on
January 6th.

The Electoral College has been criticized as undemocratic because it
gives disproportionate weight to small states. It has also been criticized
for allowing faithless electors—electors who vote contrary to how they were
pledged to vote.

However, defenders of the Electoral College point out that it forces
candidates to campaign nationwide rather than just in heavily populated
urban areas. They also argue that it protects against tyranny of the
majority.

In recent years, there has been growing support for abolishing the
Electoral College in favor of direct popular vote. However, doing so would
require amending the U.S. Constitution—a difficult process that requires
approval by two-thirds of both houses of Congress and ratification by three-fourths
of state legislatures.

*   **检测设备**：检查实验室设备是否齐全、校准是否在有效期内，检测人员是否具备相应资质。
*   **不合格品处理**：查看不良品隔离区（Red Tag Area），了解供应商对次品的追溯和处理流程是否严谨。

*   **财务健康度**：虽然很难直接看账本，但可以通过厂房维护状况、员工精神面貌、加班情况等侧面推断其资金链是否紧张，是否存在突然倒闭的风险。

### 4. 审核社会责任与合规性（ESG）

*   **劳动权益**：检查是否存在童工、强迫劳动、超时加班未给加班费、工资发放是否及时等问题。
*   **EHS**（环境、健康与安全）：消防通道是否畅通、危化品存储是否规范、废气废水处理是否符合当地法规。一旦供应商在此类问题上违规，采购商将面临巨大的声誉和法律风险。

### Definitions

In this article:

1. "Affiliate" means:
   i. a person who directly or indirectly owns, controls, or holds with power to vote, twenty percent or more of the outstanding voting securities of the debtor other than a person who holds the securities:
      A. as a fiduciary or attorney-in-fact without sole discretionary power to vote the securities;
      B. merely to secure a debt, if the person has not actually exercised the power to vote;
      C. while carrying as underwriter securities acquired in an underwriting which have not all been sold or distributed by him; or
      D. where such ownership does not of itself confer actual control over management policy;
   
   ii. a corporation twenty percent or more of whose outstanding voting securities are directly or indirectly owned, controlled, or held with power to vote by the debtor or a person described in subparagraph i of this paragraph;
   
   iv. a person whose business is operated by another under a lease or other agreement if substantially all of the leased or rented property is used in the business and the lessor or recipient of the rental payments, directly or indirectly, owns, controls or holds with power to vote fifty percent or more of the outstanding voting securities of the operator of the business; or
   
   v. a person who operates his own business under a lease or other arrangement if substantially all of his leased or rented property is owned by the lessor or recipient of rental payments who directly or indirectly owns, controls or holds with power to vote fifty percent or more of his outstanding voting securities.

2. "Asset" means property of a debtor but the term does not include:
   i. property to extent it is encumbered by valid lien;
   ii. property to extent it is generally exempt under nonbankruptcy exemption law; or
   iii. transfer to extent it is simultaneously exchanged for reasonably equivalent value.

3. "Consideration" may include satisfaction or securing of present or antecedent debt by money or money's worth.
